Header: Cochliobolus miyabeanus ( Helminthosporium oryza ) Nthomba za m'mpunga

Prevention: Burn stubble after harvest to remove infected material for the next crop
Use disease-free certified seed - Plant at recommended spacing: 6 seeds per station at 23cm by 23cm.
Plant at start of rainy season in
Apply potassium to correct deficiency (66kg muriate of
Rice is more susceptible if the soil is deficient in potassium
Avoid irrigating from infected to uninfected plots
In suseptible areas get fungicide treated seed from a registered seed company or research station
Monitoring: Additional relevant crops: maize, sorghum and other cereals
Look for disease symptoms on leaves soon after emergence - numerous oval spots, chocolate brown or light brown greyish centres with margins
On older leaves the lesions are initially small, circular, and dark brown to purple- brown.
Fully developed lesions are circular to oval with a light brown to grey center, surrounded by a reddish brown margin
Start to employ control measures when 2-5 % of the tillers are infected
Direct Control: Uproot and destroy by burning or burying severely infected plants
Restrictions: Use personal protective equipment when handling and applying pesticides, follow the label recommendations.
Do not eat, drink, smoke when mixing or applying pesticides.
U - Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use.
Do not enter the field until the spray has dried.
